first_page: Practice page /learn/ for a learner who wants to practise one skill until it sticks. First: arithmetic to algebra skills with generated problems, checked answers, a hint ladder and a worked solution, mastery levels (Familiar to Mastered) and spaced review kept on the device, plus "quiz me" decks from study-cards.
